name: Ray’s Contact Form
author: rayseocompany

sections.description:
Ray’s Contact Form is a lightweight and flexible form builder for WordPress that helps you create beautiful forms easily and quickly. You can create contact forms, custom forms, and more with built-in submission storage and spam protection. Apply beautiful built-in themes to your forms in a single click. No coding knowledge or experience required, change the theme of your form in a single click.

Our Live Preview panel helps you see the live preview of your form while you build the form. All forms are fully responsive and even the Live Preview panel will help you preview your form for a desktop, tablet and mobile phone.

Features

  • Build unlimited forms
  • 15 Built-In Themes
  • Lightweight and Fast
  • Basic Form Fields
  • Live Form Preview
  • Fully Responsive
  • Email Notifications
  • Submission Management
  • CSV Export
  • Spam protection with Honeypot

Video Tutorial

Create, configure and publish your contact form in just 3 minutes!

Use Cases

You can use Ray’s Contact Form builder to create:

Core Form Types

  • Contact forms
  • Feedback forms
  • Inquiry forms
  • Support request forms

Marketing & Lead Generation

  • Lead capture forms
  • Newsletter signup forms
  • Campaign landing forms
  • Quote request forms
  • Consultation booking forms

Sales & Business Operations

  • Order forms (basic)
  • Service request forms
  • Booking and appointment forms
  • Vendor inquiry forms
  • Partnership forms

Customer Support & Help Desk

  • Support request forms
  • Help desk ticket forms
  • Bug report forms
  • Technical issue forms
  • Customer service inquiries

Healthcare & Medical

  • Patient intake forms
  • Appointment request forms
  • Medical history forms
  • Consent and waiver forms
  • Telehealth inquiry forms

Compliance & Legal

  • Consent forms
  • Terms acceptance forms
  • GDPR/Privacy request forms
  • Data access request forms
  • Waiver and release forms

Education & Training

  • Student registration forms
  • Course enrollment forms
  • Feedback and evaluation forms
  • Application forms

Events & Registrations

  • Event registration forms
  • RSVP forms
  • Ticket request forms
  • Attendee information forms

Internal & Administrative

  • Employee request forms
  • Internal feedback forms
  • HR forms
  • Incident report forms

Custom Forms

  • Personal Forms
  • Event RSVP forms
  • Volunteer signup forms
  • School forms
  • Household information forms

General Usage

Who should use Ray’s Contact Form?

Ray’s Contact Form is designed for businesses, agencies, developers, freelancers, nonprofits, educational organizations, and personal websites that need flexible and customizable forms for WordPress.

Do I need coding skills to use Ray’s Contact Form?

No. Ray’s Contact Form includes an easy-to-use form builder that allows you to create and manage forms without writing code.

What types of forms can I create?

You can build contact forms, lead generation forms, survey forms, support request forms, registration forms and fully custom multi-field forms.

Can I create forms for different industries?

Yes. Ray’s Contact Form can be used for healthcare, education, customer support, marketing, legal compliance, internal business workflows, personal projects, and more.

Features & Functionality

Which form fields are supported?

Ray’s Contact Form supports a wide range of fields including text fields, email fields, textarea fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons and more.

Can I export form submissions?

Yes. Form submissions can be exported from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I create multi-column forms?

The free version creates single-column forms. Ray’s Contact Form (Pro) supports flexible multi-column layouts.

Does the plugin include customizable themes?

Yes. The plugin includes multiple form themes and styling options to help match your website design.

Can I preview forms before publishing?

Yes. The plugin includes a live form preview system.

Performance & Compatibility

Will Ray’s Contact Form slow down my website?

No. The plugin is built to be lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is Ray’s Contact Form compatible with modern WordPress themes?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with modern WordPress themes and block-based websites.

Does the plugin support Gutenberg?

Yes. Forms can be embedded into WordPress content using blocks or shortcodes.

Is Ray’s Contact Form translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is built using WordPress internationalization standards and supports translations.

Security & Privacy

Does Ray’s Contact Form include spam protection?

Yes. The plugin includes built-in spam prevention techniques such as honeypot protection.

Is the plugin GDPR friendly?

Yes. Ray’s Contact Form is designed with WordPress privacy and data handling best practices in mind.

Are submissions stored securely?

Yes. Form submissions are stored securely within your WordPress database.

Advanced & Developer Features

Can developers extend Ray’s Contact Form?

Yes. The plugin is built with a modular architecture that is developer-friendly and suitable for customization.

Support & Updates

Is Ray’s Contact Form free?

Yes. The core plugin is free to use. You can design a form with all basic fields with 15 built-in themes and use it freely.

Where can I report bugs or request features?

You can report issues or request features through the plugin support page on RaySEOCompany.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rays-contact-form directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Ray’s Contact Form in the admin menu.
  4. Create your first form and start collecting submissions.
